title: Saturday Walking Workout · October 17
note: Saturday morning · 30-minute treadmill walking workout. Flat incline to start. Keep effort conversational; power walking should be moderately challenging, not jogging. If 3.9–4.1 mph disrupts natural walking stride, slow down. Stop for chest discomfort, dizziness, unusual palpitations, or groin/back pain.

items.name: Warm-up walk
items.instructions: Walk tall, keep shoulders relaxed, and breathe comfortably.
